msg: The gnomes work in pairs, I selected green and brown to start, when they started yielding less than 3 mushrooms, I switched to purple and pink/red until they started yielding low. So, they work in pairs green and brown, and pink/red and purple, they will give up to 9 mushrooms, and as low as 0, when I received zero I switched to the opposite pair. I earned over 1000 points using this method
